title: Get a permit to busk or perform in public places
what: Get the council's permit before busking or performing in streets or other public places.

laws.title: Town of Mosman Park Activities on Thoroughfares and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law

sources.title: Town of Mosman Park Activities on Thoroughfares and Trading in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law
